gen-flavors-gf-hind-madurai: Whimsical and loud, Flavors towers up front with stubby, pencil-thick strokes. Hind Madurai follows in a friendly sans, so give it a comfortable size and it will fill each line with sturdy, wide-curved lowercase.
gen-flavors-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru keeps its lowercase tall and tidy, with each a left slightly ajar. Flavors does its best work shouting with thick diagonals and a towering x-height, while Hind Mysuru does its best work quietly carrying sentences without any calligraphic thinning.
gen-flavors-gf-hind-siliguri: Approachable at heart, Hind Siliguri hums along in a flat gray texture, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle. And Flavors steps in above it, towering and stubby, so the page gets one loud voice and one that simply carries the words.
gen-flavors-gf-hind-vadodara: Hind Vadodara draws its rounded letters with generous gaps and tall-bowled e and a shapes. Flavors is the one that makes noise, with its heavy diagonals and pencil-stub height, while Hind Vadodara is the one that settles into quiet, uniform text.
gen-flavors-gf-huninn: Huninn reads modern and tidy, its lowercase rising close to cap height with crossbars as fat as the stems. Give it a size that lets those tidy shapes breathe.
gen-flavors-gf-inter-tight: Chunky meets compact. Flavors swaggers with towering, pencil-stub letters, while Inter Tight stays low and tucked in, its ascenders barely clearing the lowercase and its curve tails held back, which makes the loudest-versus-quietest split the pair's best quality.
gen-flavors-gf-karla: Whimsical and heavy, Flavors has arches as thick as its stems, which makes Karla's stocky, tall-middled lowercase feel lighter. And a body size a notch larger lets that gaping c opening show off.
gen-flavors-gf-kedebideri: Flavors is built from uniform strokes with almost no contrast, towering and bold. Kedebideri takes over in the text with a skyward x-height and rounded, inviting letters, so a long passage feels open and friendly.
gen-flavors-gf-khula: Flavors has no brush-style swelling, just blunt diagonals and a towering x-height. Khula sits against that with a tall midsection and curves holding their mouths open, and that loud-versus-quiet gap is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-flavors-gf-krub: Krub reads with a pronounced x-height and pen-lifted curves that leave their loops unfinished, set against Flavors' tubing-gauge stems. A slightly larger size suits the body.
